items.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Create one square finished game spell illustration, 圣光之源, by repainting input 1 in the rough broad-brush hand-painted anime language of input 3.
REFERENCE ROLES: Input 1 (holy-source-v2.png) locks composition, pose, framing, lighting, background and the large opening sheet of holy light. Input 2 (xingyue.webp) locks Xingyue's identity, hair silhouette, gold eyes, white crescent ornament and white priestess dress with dark forest teal cape; its white background, lantern and prayer pose must not transfer. Input 3 (hero-summoner.webp, 花开两面) is DRAWING STYLE ONLY: borrow opaque paint masses, broad cloth strokes, grouped hair, clear anime eyes and selective hand drawing, not that woman's brown hair, green eyes, flowers or clothes.
Preserve input 1's gentle standing three-quarter turn, connected waist and hips, head at upper left, natural-sized nearer palm at waist supporting the low light edge, farther hand higher at right drawing it open, long braid at left, cape unfolding above and behind the right arm. Retain its square crop and the broad ivory light opening into the lower-right foreground. This is an open irregular luminous plane with a soft warm edge and a few broad translucent-looking value shifts painted with opaque strokes. Preserve its scale, shape and movement. Make its edge feel like light revealed rather than a rectangular fabric sheet; no physical cloth, book, card or container.
Retain the NAI image's desaturated gray-blue background throughout, simplified into quiet broad painted planes with the same value separation. Never replace it with white, a blank cutout, a landscape or a star field. Holy light softly illuminates fingers, cheek and white sleeves. Keep the face calm, mouth closed, golden gaze lowered. Hair stays extremely pale muted gold, straight fringe, rounded crown, two long cheek locks and one low thick side braid, with a flat white crescent on viewer-right. Remove ornamental tiny top braids so the crown stays quiet and coherent; no bright yellow or orange hair.

STYLE: hand-painted anime illustration built from large opaque color masses and a limited set of broad directional curved or elongated strokes. Clear grouped shadows and decisive handmade edges, with a few subtle gentle skin transitions. Stroke shape communicates the turn of a form. Keep selective overlaps, broken stroke endings and expressive coverage, surrounded by quieter areas. Do not flatten every interior into uniform solid fill; do not cover every surface in brush texture.
HAIR: coherent substantial locks and grouped masses following the actual silhouette and flow. Broad curved forms, quiet base-color regions, one or a few broad shadow turns and short irregular opaque highlight swaths. Highlights sometimes break along the lock. A few deliberate tapered ends and fine contour accents are enough. Avoid tiny facets, needle micro-locks, pale scratches, strand networks and dense flyaways. Each section of the braid is a large connected mass.
FACE: unmistakable anime proportions, clear expressive upper-lid shapes, simple golden iris masses and a few crisp highlights. Economical nose and mouth, broad clean cheek planes. Preserve readable fringe cast shadow, small nose underside plane, under-jaw shadow and neck turn. A few tapered colored line accents at lower eyelids, eye folds and jaw-to-neck transitions explain anatomy. Slight warm/cool midtone turns allowed, selectively restrained.
BODY AND CLOTH: principal broad fold planes follow shoulder, chest, elbows and torso direction beneath the white priestess dress and dark teal cape. Use elongated curved opaque strokes, a few selective crease/contour accents at collar and major tension points. A couple broad midtone turns connect volume. Large quiet cloth areas remain. Make hands anatomically readable, five fingers per hand, naturally connected wrists, relaxed fingertips. Simplify gold trim into a few purposeful painted accents. Avoid disconnected triangular mosaics, dense wrinkle networks, glossy material and elaborate metal ornament.
COLOR: muted colored grays, pale gold hair, white dress with warm gray and soft cool shadow planes, dark forest teal cape, gold eyes and restrained warm holy-light edge. Clearly group light and shadow. Faces, eyes, hands and luminous gesture receive the clearest selective drawing; secondary clothing and background are economical. Confident simplified finish with large directional paint marks, no photoreal skin, glossy 3D, airbrushed commercial splash art, all-over grain/canvas filters, excessive rim glow, uniformly traced outlines or decorative clutter. No text, frame, watermark or UI.
